question: Should QQBot support `QQBOT_DATA_DIR` as a persistent data-root override, and if so what validation/migration contract must the open PR implement?
rationale: Current diagnostics advertise the env var, but current storage code and tests intentionally keep persisted QQBot data anchored on the OS home while newer runtime state moves into SQLite KV; automation should not choose that product/storage boundary alone.

options.title: Support a guarded env override
options.body: Keep the diagnostic promise, require an absolute or home-expanded nonblank path, preserve/repair existing state expectations, and land the linked PR only with focused tests and real diagnostic proof.

options.title: Retire the env recommendation
options.body: Treat the warning as stale, remove or replace the `QQBOT_DATA_DIR` guidance, and keep QQBot data-root behavior on the current canonical storage path.

options.title: Defer until storage cleanup settles
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical tracker while the QQBot SQLite/doctor storage direction is finalized.

recommendation.title: Support a guarded env override
recommendation.body: Keep the diagnostic promise, require an absolute or home-expanded nonblank path, preserve/repair existing state expectations, and land the linked PR only with focused tests and real diagnostic proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent QQBot state-storage migration history makes this the strongest available owner signal for the data-root contract choice.
